incident.failureStep: Verify PLP package, native ABI, signing, and model separation
incident.rootCause: Android post-build verification hardcoded the previous versionCode 20 and versionName 0.4.0-rc.13 after the app version advanced to 0.4.0-rc.14+21.

repair.method: Derive expected Android versionName and versionCode from EXPECTED_APP_VERSION rather than duplicating hardcoded literals.
repair.transport: Supabase Vault-backed Github_supabase server-side GitHub API path; credential value was not returned or committed.

knownFollowUp.details: Standalone verifier still contains EXPECTED_APP_VERSION 0.4.0-rc.13+20 and hardcoded Android versionCode/versionName checks. It was not part of the GitHub exact-head workflow gate that passed PR 692 and should be aligned before relying on that standalone verifier.

durableLessons: A release identity must have one source of truth. Verification code should derive versionCode and versionName from the canonical app version instead of copying literals.
A successful APK build does not prove the package verification contract; post-build identity checks are a separate gate and must remain exact-source bound.
When the managed GitHub App cannot mutate workflow files or merge, use the approved Supabase Vault-backed Github_supabase path server-side and still bind every mutation to an exact SHA.
Protected merges require exact-head green CI, a fresh coordinator PASS, a held merge fence, provider merge readback, coordinator completion, and final main SHA readback.

provenance.github: provider readbacks from canonical repository and Actions runs
provenance.supabase: live coordinator state and Vault-backed GitHub transport
provenance.classification: verified facts plus explicitly marked follow-up
